name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-12-11, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.95 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
